items.title_en: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa

items.desc_en: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.

items.title_en: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
items.title_zh: 在特朗普吞并威胁后，美国和丹麦就格陵兰岛达成协议
items.desc_en: Trump said the agreement will give the US "permanent control over security, and all other needs, in Greenland", though specifics haven't been confirmed by Danish officials.
items.desc_zh: 特朗普表示，该协议将赋予美国“对格陵兰岛安全和所有其他需求的永久控制权”，但具体细节尚未得到丹麦官员的证实。
